---
applyTo: "**/*.ts"
---

# TypeScript coding instructions

- Prefer explicit types over implicit `any`.
- Use interfaces or type aliases for shared DTO and domain contracts.
- Keep functions pure and side-effect-free when possible.
- Use modern NestJS patterns: decorators, dependency injection, and validation.
- Avoid deeply nested logic; extract helper methods or dedicated services when necessary.
- Keep names readable and aligned with the business domain.
- Comments should explain intent, not describe obvious code.
- Use English for all identifiers and comments.
